title: Typed Decision Models under Prevalence Shift and Label Budgets: Decision Training, Calibration, and Implicit Priors
abstract: arXiv:2610.26325v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Typed decision models (TDMs) return probabilities over caller-defined options, and Jev's vendor describes it as calibrated. We ask whether vendor decision training improves a model over its backbone, whether a TDM's calibration and thresholds withstand prevalence (label) shift like a fine-tuned classifier's, and how many labels a trained model needs to overtake a TDM. We compare three TDMs (Jev, Tev1-4B, Nimble-9B), their base models and trained classifiers on identical candidate-set decisions from five public datasets (on intent datasets, within the gold label's intent group) under simulated shift, with 35 paired tests frozen before the confirmatory analysis (earlier test-data checks disclosed), and estimate label-budget curves. translated_title: 流行率偏移与标签预算约束下的类型化决策模型：决策训练、校准与隐式先验
translated_abstract: 类型化决策模型返回调用者所定义选项上的概率分布，Jev 的供应商宣称其模型经过校准。我们探讨三个问题：供应商的决策训练能否在其骨干模型之上带来改进；类型化决策模型的校准与阈值能否像微调分类器一样经受住流行率（标签）偏移；以及一个经过训练的模型需要多少标注标签才能超越类型化决策模型。我们在模拟偏移条件下，在来自五个公开数据集的相同候选集决策上（在意图数据集上限于黄金标签所属的意图组内），对三个类型化决策模型（Jev、Tev1-4B、Nimble-9B）与其基础模型以及经过训练的分类器进行了比较；我们在确认性分析之前冻结了 35 项配对检验（并披露了此前进行的测试数据检查），同时估计了标签预算曲线。首先，决策训练并非总是有益：与 Qwen3.5-9B 仅相差一个 LoRA 适配器的 Nimble-9B 在意图任务上校准更好，但在金融情感任务上 Macro-F1 却低了 12 个百分点（原文摘要至此被截断）。
tldr: 本文在流行率偏移与标签预算约束下系统比较三个类型化决策模型与其骨干模型及微调分类器，发现厂商决策训练并非总是有益，其校准优势因任务类型而异。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically compares three typed decision models against their backbones and fine-tuned classifiers under prevalence shift and label budgets, finding that vendor decision training is not always beneficial and its calibration advantages are task-dependent.
